note: What a server sends to load another spell into a unit's slot. The header names the unit.

bits.name: slot
bits.note: Which slot. A champion's own spells count from 0.

bits.name: summonerSlots
bits.note: Set where slot names a summoner spell's slot, clear for the unit's own spells; every kind obeys it.

fields.name: name
fields.note: The name the client loads the spell under, ended by a zero byte. A client shows the named spell's icon in the slot.
